title: Matching-prefix scan
statement: Define a map on Boolean words recursively as follows: it sends the empty word to the empty word and a one-bit word to itself. On a word beginning with $b,b'$, it retains these first two bits and then continues recursively on the remaining word if $b=b'$; if $b\ne b'$, it returns just those first two bits.
